text:
maya: heads-up: alpha-pricing rollout (cohort C, variant alpha-v3) produced duplicated invoice lines for ~12 EU accounts — low $ amounts but noisy.
ben: can you share a quick query of duplicates?
maya: ran this at 08:05 UTC:
```sql
SELECT account_id, billing_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE price_sheet='alpha-v3' AND region='eu-west' AND created_at >= '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY account_id, billing_key
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
LIMIT 50;
```
sara: results show mostly cnt=2, duplicates within ~20-40s windows.
liam: possible overlap: realtime apply + grandfathering job both writing. what's grandfather_ttl?
maya: set to 3600s. ruleset id price_sheet:v3:rev7.
ben: Ops please pause writes for alpha-v3 while we triage. we don't want more duplicates.
liam: applied write-lock on billing writer for alpha-v3 in eu-west (lock token lock-2032500000). TTL 20m.
ops-bot: lock applied.
maya: finance approval: auto-merge duplicates < $50 and auto-issue credits for remainder? exposure capped at $1k. approve?
ben: approve auto-merge < $50 now. >$50 escalate to finance lead.
sara: queued bulk dedupe job (dry-run). making FIN tickets for affected accounts.
liam: opening INF-3361 for race condition between gf-job and price-apply. prototyping conditional upsert for invoice_lines keyed by billing_key.
ops-bot: INF-3361 created and assigned to eng-platform.
maya: will run reconciliation and post net-revenue delta here by EOD. leaving thread open until done.
ben: thanks all. tag finance-leads for visibility.
ops-bot: archival reminder: thread auto-archives in 90 days.
